notes.title: Hot sauce flight scorecards
notes.content:
Flight card: every bottle poured gets punch (out of 10) x burn (minutes till my mouth goes quiet); heat points = punch x burn, written plain ASCII like 'punch 7 x burn 5 = 35 HP'. Cards stay ranked hottest first.
Stove rule: when a bottle breaks the house heat record, the flight table has officially outgrown its safety gear — step up ONE rung on the fire-extinguisher ladder (the next model up by price from the one I last staged; I start from the First Alert Kitchen Fire Extinguisher already mounted by the stove), stage it in my real Amazon cart (staged, never bought — I check out myself before the next flight night), and add its price to the running hazard tally written plain like 12.50 for the house budget sheet.
Widow's Porch (habanero-peach) — punch 7 x burn 5 = 35 HP. House record.
Smoke & Mirrors (chipotle) — punch 5 x burn 3 = 15 HP.
